Identity management and payments-infrastructure group across three segments: Identity Management (biometric ID, card personalization for financial/healthcare/corporate clients via Card Centre Nigeria), Payments/Transactional Systems (switching via ChamsSwitch, ATM deployment via Chams Access, mobile money via ChamsMobile), and ICT Training - plus a 2026 pivot into AI/data-centre infrastructure via new subsidiary ChamsCorp. One standing caveat shared with ETRANZACT: mobile money operators sometimes earn interest on pooled customer float balances rather than passing it through - ChamsMobile's treatment of this is unconfirmed and sits at the financial-ratio layer, not a business-activity concern.

CORRECTED from original PASS classification, which mistakenly treated this as a property-holding REIT. MOFI Real Estate Investment Fund (MREIF) is actually a government-backed mortgage lending vehicle, not a rental-property trust - its core business is originating fixed-rate mortgage loans to homebuyers at a stated 9.75% interest rate (well below commercial bank rates of 18-22%), plus construction financing guarantees to developers, with repayments recycled into new loans. Interest-bearing lending is the core product, not an incidental tenant-mix issue like genuine property REITs (NREIT, UPDCREIT, SFSREIT, UHOMREIT) - same category as the mortgage banks (INFINITY, LIVINGTRUST) already marked FAIL.
Pharmaceuticals/consumer health - permissible core activity.
Telecom services - permissible core activity.
Food/starch processing - permissible core activity.
Mining/resources holding - permissible core activity.

Own operated business (NGX Exchange, NGX RegCo, NGX RelCo) is fee-based - listing/trading fees, market data, regulation, real estate - not itself riba, comparable to how most global exchange operators are treated. Complication sits in the Strategic Investment segment: NGX Group holds equity stakes in CSCS and NASD (fine, fee-based) but also in FMDQ Securities Exchange, a market dedicated almost entirely to conventional bond/money-market/FX trading. Stake size and FMDQ's own revenue mix are unconfirmed - determines whether this is an immaterial minority holding or a taint on the parent. Genuine scholarly judgment call, not resolved by financial ratios alone.

CORRECTED from original PASS/VERIFY classification. Nigeria Infrastructure Debt Fund is explicitly a debt fund, not a property-holding trust - it makes primarily debt investments in infrastructure projects, targeting a gross return of 3.00-4.50% over comparable FGN bond yields, with 80% of assets in senior debt/securitised debt/loans to government agencies. Income to unit-holders comes from coupon and fees received from borrowers. This is interest-based lending as the core, explicit product (not incidental), same category as MOFIREIF, INFINITY, and LIVINGTRUST.

Core quick-service restaurant business remains clean (verify no alcohol sales at any outlet, as previously noted). However, wholly owned subsidiary Tantainment Limited runs a 'live-game show' platform called 'Chances by Tantainment' (Q2 2026 launch, ~N30bn valuation, 10% stake sold to RGM Materials Solutions for N2bn). Public disclosures don't clarify whether 'Chances' involves real-money wagering/betting by viewers or is a production-funded prize/entertainment format - the name, emphasis on 'regulatory and compliance frameworks,' and 'tech-driven platform' framing warrant direct verification (terms of participation, NLRC or state gaming-authority licensing status) before resolving either way. FAIL if wagering-based; PASS likely holds if it's a skill/entertainment format with no player-side stakes.

The Initiates Plc - Nigeria's only listed environmental/waste management solutions company. Core activities: hazardous and non-hazardous waste treatment, asbestos handling, wastewater treatment, e-waste processing, thermal desorption, and industrial cleaning/decontamination services, primarily serving the Oil & Gas sector. ISO 9001:2015 and 14001:2015 certified. Expanding via majority-owned Uganda subsidiary, funded through internal cash flow (no conventional debt). No lending/insurance/alcohol/gambling exposure - a clean, regulation-driven service business.
